Exemptions are allowed subject to all just exceptions.
2. Both the applications stand disposed of.
1. For the reasons stated in the application, the same is allowed.
2. Application stands disposed of.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.198/2017 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Sarai Rohilla on the ground that the parties have settled their disputes vide Compromise Deed dated 8 th December, 2021 arrived at between them with the facilitation of Delhi Mediation Centre, Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi, which is on record of this Court.

2. As per the FIR, petitioner no.1 was married to respondent no.2 on 3 rd February, 2016 but due to disputes and differences, the marriage was dissolved by mutual consent vide decree of divorce dated 18th October, 2022.
No child was born out of this wedlock.
3. Petitioner no.1 is now residing in London and is represented by Smt. Suman, SPA.

Both Smt.
Suman and respondent no.2-complianant are present in the Court and have been duly identified by their respective counsels as also the IO.

4. As per settlement, balance sum of Rs.6 lakhs is tendered to respondent No.2 in the Court today vide Demand Draft No.160714 drawn on Indian Bank, Kirti Nagar Branch dated 16th December,
2022 which is duly received and acknowledged by respondent No.2 towards full and final settlement of all her claims.
